falcon_mcp/common/api_scopes.py maps GetSearchStatusV1 to NGSIEM:read as the poll step of search_ngsiem
falcon_mcp/common/api_scopes.py maps StopSearchV1 to NGSIEM:write for search_ngsiem cleanup

falcon_mcp/common/api_scopes.py maps api_preempt_proxy_post_graphql to Identity Protection Entities, Timeline, Detections, and Assessment :read plus Identity Protection GraphQL:write for idp_investigate_entity, which builds only `query` documents
